entry.summary: It appears that there is an issue with the readability of the text format, particularly when accessing it from a cellphone. The problem specifically begins at the midpoint of the document, affecting the user's ability to read the content properly on their mobile device. This issue could be related to the formatting or layout that does not adapt well to smaller screens. It would be beneficial to review and possibly revise the document's formatting to ensure it is accessible and readable on all devices, including mobile phones. This adjustment will enhance the user experience by making the information more accessible regardless of the device used to view the text.
